understanding.goal_understanding: The goal is to complete the KA59 puzzle game by solving each level: place every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked '+' so that all goals are occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN, then proceed through all levels until the run reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move shifts the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction unless blocked by a wall/boundary or an immovable object; some adjacent objects are pushable blocks and can be pushed if directly in the movement direction. Levels may have multiple selectable pieces; using CLICK with an exact object pixel position switches which piece is controlled. The movement_blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not guarantee a move will fail.
